items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: We just played in Berlin with a guy Han Bennink... Blackwell was basically a traditional player in a lot of ways... I play a lot of — Blackwell was basically a traditional player

ctx.x: Because I know the tune comes back later.
Yeah, this is a tune called “Tune In.” So everybody has the melody. And Blackwell plays with his eyes closed so he doesn’t need any music.
I was just going to ask about that.
